scenes.title: Rolling a new name
scenes.narration: Zooming in on the name maker. It is only a few lines, but it has to promise one thing: no two links ever share a name.

nodes.label: randomCode(7)
nodes.step: Pick 7 characters from 62 (a-z, A-Z, 0-9) using a secure random source.

nodes.label: INSERT
nodes.step: Try to save it. The code column is the primary key.

nodes.label: unique error?
nodes.step: Did Postgres say the code is already taken (error 23505)?

nodes.label: try again (max 5)
nodes.step: Yes: roll a fresh name and try again, up to 5 times.

nodes.label: 500 error
nodes.step: Five clashes in a row would mean something is very wrong: give up with a 500.

points: The database is the judge of 'unique', not the code: two servers rolling at the same moment cannot both win.
b % 62 is very slightly uneven (256 is not a multiple of 62). Harmless for short links, not for passwords.
